data.name: Ivo
data.gender_notes: Ivo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Ivus', meaning 'yew'. The name Ivo was used by the early Christians as a masculine name, possibly symbolizing the strong and enduring nature of the yew tree. The name Ivo carries the meaning “Yew, Friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ivo usually hope their child will grow to embody yew, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of strength, resilience, and enduring faith.
data.etymology: Ivo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Yew, Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ivo total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
data.cultural_impact: Ivo was believed to be a popular name among the early Christians and Europeans during the Middle Ages. The name was common in various European countries, including France, Spain, and Portugal. Additionally, Ivo is also the name of several saints including Saint Ivo of Chartres (a 12th-century French judge and theologian), Saint Ivo of Braga (a 6th-century Spanish bishop), and Saint Ivo of Rossano (an Italian monk).
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ivo carries a deep spiritual significance for Christians. The yew tree, from which the name derives, was considered sacred in many cultures due to its longevity and resilience. The name Ivo is thus associated with the idea of strength, endurance, and eternal life. In Christian tradition, the name also signifies the virtue of steadfastness and the embrace of the cross - the yew tree's branch formations resemble the shape of a cross. Overall, Ivo is a powerful and meaningful name that celebrates faith, resilience, and spiritual growth.
